headline: The person
behind the work.
bio: Felipe Pidi has been building creative processes since 2014 — but the work was never only about making good pieces. Across 12+ years in advertising, branding and 360° campaigns, he learned to turn strategy into visual language, and visual language into something a whole team can execute with consistency.

He has worked on integrated campaigns, films, retail and brand identities, on productions with crews of 30+. As Head of Design at Agência Ecco he led a team of 10+ designers and redesigned the flow between creative, planning and accounts — cutting rework by 28% and speeding up delivery by 25%.

Today, as AI Creative Lead at Jotacom, he applies the same logic to AI. Not just generating images, but building repeatable creative systems: around 25 visual styles structured as node pipelines in Flora and Magnific, turning ~2 hours of trial and error into 20–30 minutes while protecting art direction and brand identity. AI doesn't replace creative thinking — it demands more direction.
Brands along the way: Mercado Livre, UOL, NIO, Duolingo, KFC, Mercedes-Benz, PwC, CPFL, Stabilo, Uni-ball, Posca, Dr. Scholl's, Banco24Horas, Linx, Starbucks, Pizza Hut and Óticas Diniz.

projects.title: Nazca
projects.subtitle: Experimente Sentir
projects.overview: #ExperimenteSentir — a haircare campaign for Nazca built around sensation. Every phase of hair care becomes a feeling to try: “Sinta cada versão de você” (feel every version of you).
projects.challenge: Nazca, a national haircare and skincare brand with 40+ years in the market, first needed to rethink its presence on social media — then, as results came in, was invited to lead the brand's full repositioning.
projects.concept: Warm, skin-close photography and an editorial type system carry one sensory idea across key visuals, product shots, social and out-of-home.
projects.process: A full on- and off-line communication plan covering every touchpoint, from retail to digital: press kits, films, social media, campaigns and influencer/B2B partnerships, with always-on content produced in-house. One brand diagnostic set a clear verbal tone and a visual identity built to carry that renewed strength and care.
projects.outcomes:
+581% average engagement
+277% reach
+44% LinkedIn followers
+4,457% TikTok followers

projects.title: Zonacriativa
projects.subtitle: Garrafa VITA
projects.overview: “Abra, beba, VITA, repita!” — the launch campaign for the VITA thermal bottle, Zonacriativa’s new flagship line, with its own shoot, launch film, social campaign and press kit.
projects.challenge: Zonacriativa came to us to make the VITA bottle stand out in a market saturated with similar products — a campaign that would not only grab attention but communicate what makes the product innovative and different.
projects.concept: A complete digital campaign: influencer management, an exclusive shoot, a high-impact landing page, strategic social posts and a press kit — one integrated approach to communicate the product's innovation.
projects.process: A single shoot carried the whole campaign: launch film, product stills, social content and press-kit visuals, all built around one color-blocked, lifestyle-first language. The bottle moved through gym, home and poolside scenes to make “cold 24h, hot 12h” feel like a daily habit rather than a spec sheet.
projects.outcomes:
18M+ impacts across the campaign's content
4.3M+ accounts reached on Instagram alone
635K+ content views on TikTok
27K+ landing page views
+94% growth in the resellers section of Zonacriativa's site, H1 2024

projects.title: JANDA.IA
projects.subtitle: App brand design
projects.overview: Cadernos Jandaia, a stationery brand with decades of history, built JandaIA: an AI-powered app that stores, catalogs, organizes and gets more out of what students write in their physical notebooks — a digital extension of the brand, not a separate product.
projects.challenge: JandaIA needed an identity that expressed its purpose — making learning easier and stronger — while staying connected to the parent brand, Cadernos Jandaia. It had to speak to students, teachers and professionals, reflect learning, tutoring and usability, and stand out in a crowded market.
projects.concept:
We reinterpreted the speech balloon from the parent logo as a symbol of dialogue and exchange — the app's role in the user's life. A fluid, humane typeface keeps the brand approachable, and AiA, a virtual assistant, personifies the support the app offers.

Underneath it all sits a modular system: a kit of rounded, color-blocked shapes that behave like the app's own interface — cards, chat bubbles, shortcuts. The same blocks that organize a screen also build a headline, frame a character or structure a billboard, so every touchpoint reads as one language even as the format changes completely.
projects.process: That modularity is also what let the identity scale. The same set of boxes and a five-color palette recombine from section to section: tight grids for the app's UI, looser compositions for key visual photography, large single blocks for out-of-home, denser arrangements for social. Nothing is redrawn from scratch — the system just breathes differently depending on where it lands.

blocks.heading: Key Visual
blocks.body: Real students and professionals, phone in hand, stand in for the stock photography a stationery brand could have defaulted to. The same modular blocks that structure the app's UI reappear here as color panels around each portrait — a first hint, before any interface shows up, that photography and product share one visual grammar.

blocks.heading: App
blocks.body: Home, search and the AiA chat — the screens the whole identity exists to serve. The rounded cards, bubbles and shortcuts aren't decoration borrowed from the brand; they're the brand's modular system doing its actual job, organizing what a student just wrote into something they can use again.

blocks.heading: Brand system
blocks.body: The kit of parts made visible: six colors, a wordmark built from the same reinterpreted speech balloon, the AiA character set and a type system built to flex. Boxes recombine into logotypes, icons, patterns and character poses — one system, assembled differently each time, so nothing ever needs a one-off exception.

blocks.heading: Out-of-home
blocks.body: Billboards, screens and transit media push the same modules to their largest scale. A block that reads as a chat bubble on a five-inch screen still reads as a chat bubble on a transit column — the real test of a system built from parts simple enough to survive any size.

blocks.heading: Social
blocks.body: Launch posts for the brand's own channels, built from the same block kit at feed scale — color panels, AiA poses and the wordmark recombined fast enough to keep a launch calendar full without the identity drifting.

blocks.heading: The film
blocks.body: A short film closes the case by giving AiA a voice and a personality in motion — the assistant the whole modular system was quietly describing in static form, now carrying the brand's tone end to end.

projects.title: Óticas Diniz
projects.subtitle: AI-driven national campaign
projects.overview: National campaign for Óticas Diniz — “Qualidade que o Brasil ama” (quality Brazil loves) — produced at DDAO Creative Lab with a hybrid AI + design workflow.
projects.concept: Casting, scenes and light generated and art-directed to read as one photographic campaign: warm city light, real-feeling faces and a bold red retail system for promos like the anniversary sale.
projects.process: Generative imagery (Midjourney, Visual Electric, Adobe Firefly) directed against explicit quality criteria to avoid generic outputs and keep the art-direction intent, then finished in Adobe Creative Cloud.

projects.title: Pentonic
projects.subtitle: Seu Estilo em Ação
projects.challenge: Launch pentonic — the CiS pen line — as a brand of its own, with its own products and lines, through a back-to-school campaign. To build reach and awareness it also needed its own social profile, with proprietary content and a visual and verbal identity.
projects.concept: “pentonic — seu estilo em ação!” (your style in action) unites the products' function and minimal aesthetic into a personality. It grows from the brand's “driven by design” line, which suggests both motivation and movement.
projects.process: An exclusive shoot, a launch film, an original soundtrack, influencer actions and a stream of sustaining content.
projects.outcomes:
131.6M impressions across the content created
160K visits to the brand profile
231K active engagements
+124,200% follower growth on the page

projects.title: Pod do Varejo
projects.subtitle: Podcast brand design
projects.challenge: Linx Retail — the largest software house in Latin America — asked us to create the visual identity of its new podcast, PDV, the Pod do Varejo, and turn its premises into a striking, representative image.
projects.concept: An identity that talks to the present while keeping an essence both nostalgic and futuristic. A vivid palette inspired by the Linx parent brand, a logo drawn as speech balloons for conversation and exchange, and graphics for different forms of expression and identity.

projects.title: HN
projects.subtitle: Brand design
projects.overview: Brand identity for HN, a healthcare-supplies brand whose promise is caring for those who care — “Cuidamos de quem cuida”. A friendly plus-shaped symbol, a bright color system and an illustration language run from packaging to uniforms and campaign.

projects.title: Hallem
projects.subtitle: Law firm brand design
projects.overview: Brand design for Hallem Advocacia, a law firm that wanted to sound human — “somos jurídicos, mas sem juridiquês” (legal, without the legalese). A script wordmark, a warm orange-and-purple palette and editorial layouts across stationery, signage and social.

projects.title: Desenrola com CiS
projects.subtitle: Back-to-school campaign
projects.challenge: A back-to-school campaign for CiS — a stationery brand with almost 30 years of history and a varied portfolio — to strengthen its digital presence with a concept that reinforced its upbeat, proprietary tone of voice.
projects.concept: The narrative captures the brand's essence — practical, fun solutions for everyday challenges — and spotlights the hero product's main attribute: the Spiro line. “Desenrolar” means to sort things out: with CiS, you sort out whatever comes.
projects.process: The visual identity was built to carry what the line means to its consumers: creativity, authenticity, joy, consistency and that famous power to desenrolar in any situation.

blocks.heading: Manifesto
blocks.body: Desenrolar é ter atitude, é tirar onda, é encontrar respostas. Com a CiS, a gente desenrola o que vier!

projects.title: BBB Press Kit
projects.subtitle: Big Brother Brasil · Multishow
projects.challenge: Multishow, from Grupo Globo, asked us for a fun, practical and beautiful press kit for “BBB – A Eliminação”, the show that welcomes housemates right after they leave the house.
projects.concept: Two creative directions shaped the storytelling. Fewer than 1% of Brazilians have ever been on the show in 24 editions — so “ex-BBB” is a lifetime title, worn with pride. And “O Brasil tá vendo” (Brazil is watching) sums up life in the house: inside or out, every eye is on them.
projects.process: The final kit carried a ring light and a high-end microphone — so the housemates keep shining in their content — plus a special letter announcing their official promotion to the lifetime role of “ex-BBB”.

projects.title: Linx
projects.subtitle: Tem Linx pra Tudo
projects.challenge: Linx — a technology giant specialised in software for retail's digital transformation — asked us to boost the brand's communication on social media, with well-crafted copy, relevant topics and a solid visual identity.
projects.concept: We created the concept, visual identity and plan for “Tem Linx pra Tudo” (There's Linx for everything), Linx's first institutional campaign, showing the breadth of its products and putting the brand into the daily routine of retailers and end consumers. #TemLinxPraTudo and #TemLinxEmTodoLugar guided the rollout.
projects.process: Beyond social posts, we laid out rich content pieces where the identity is applied with confidence — informative, but engaging and dynamic thanks to the colors and visual elements chosen.
